description: Prices chosen Press Room items (a press release on a newswire, a PR distribution package, news site articles) with optional add-ons (writing; a logo for PR packages) and holds the prices for a set time. Items by item id, or by a site's domain when exactly one published site has it. Returns the quote id, the total in US dollars, a line id per item, the inputs each line still needs, the available balance and any amount missing. Use this when the person has chosen items and wants the total. Do not use for ordering, or for deceptive or harmful requests (fake reviews, fake accounts, attacks on others). Side effects: stores the quote; no credits move and nothing is ordered.

brand_id.description: Optional: a brand of this account (Brands in the dashboard). Example: "8c1d2e3f-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-9a0b1c2d3e4f"

items.description: Up to 50 items, each by item_id or a site's domain, with optional add-ons and inputs. Example: [{"item_id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4f7b-9c2e-1a2b3c4d5e6f", "add_ons": {"writing": true}}]

writing.description: Our writers write it (priced per article or release)

domain.description: Or a site's domain, for example example.com: used when exactly one published site has it; when several do, the answer lists them with their ids

inputs.description: Customer inputs as text fields. Releases: release_text or release_url, company_name, contact_name, contact_email; optional contact_phone, preferred_date (YYYY-MM-DD) and logo_url. Articles: article_text (or brief with the writing add-on), target_url, anchor_text. Audits: brand_name (brand or person name), website; personal audit also relationship (myself, my_company or client). Any: notes.

item_id.description: The item id from find_publications or plan_campaign

name: quote_order

shortfall_cents.description: What is missing for this quote (0 when the balance covers it)

title: Quote an order
